{{Top|leg}}
The '''Golden Sun coral''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Coral/Legends|coral]] polyp that formed a group minded sentient being with considerable connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] called the [[Golden Sun]]. The polyps fed by filtering microorganisms from the [[Water/Legends|water]].
